protocol.alignment: Exact timestamps only; no interpolation or future values; gap <=1.5*training schema nominal interval
protocol.quality: Good finite required roles in both sample endpoints, >=90% expected pairs per complete minute and >=20 pairs
protocol.initial_context_limit: First fully usable target value per run/asset, retained causally. Full run batch only; not an online chunk API or a measured ambient temperature.
protocol.combination: Union with unchanged baseline threshold; no baseline alert can be lost
protocol.gate: More cooling events, false windows <= baseline, precision >= .5
protocol.selection: Most cooling, physical, total events; then fewer false windows and preference for no initial context
